datasets.title: Carbon dioxide in the air (Mauna Loa)
datasets.mission: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, Mauna Loa Observatory
datasets.citation: Lan, X., P. Tans and K. W. Thoning, NOAA GML Mauna Loa CO2 monthly mean data. https://gml.noaa.gov/ccgg/trends/
datasets.explain: Carbon dioxide in the air, measured on a Hawaiian mountain since 1958.

datasets.title: Indian Ocean Dipole index (DMI)
datasets.mission: HadISST sea surface temperature (Saji et al. 1999 dipole mode index)
datasets.citation: Saji, N. H. et al., 1999, Nature 401, 360-363; data NOAA PSL https://psl.noaa.gov/gcos_wgsp/Timeseries/DMI/
datasets.explain: Indian Ocean Dipole: a see-saw of warm water between the west and east Indian Ocean that steers the monsoon.

datasets.title: Global average temperature (NASA GISTEMP v4)
datasets.mission: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis v4
datasets.citation: GISTEMP Team, 2026: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP), version 4. NASA GISS. https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/
datasets.explain: The whole planet's average temperature compared with normal.

datasets.title: Surface temperature (NASA GISTEMP v4)
datasets.mission: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis v4 (GHCNv4 stations + ERSSTv5 oceans)
datasets.citation: GISTEMP Team, 2026: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP), version 4. NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies. https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/ ; Lenssen, N. et al., 2024: A NASA GISTEMPv4 observational uncertainty ensemble. J. Geophys. Res. Atmos., 129, e2023JD040179.
datasets.explain: How much warmer or cooler each place is than its own normal, from weather stations and ships.

datasets.title: Evaporation from land (NASA GLDAS)
datasets.mission: NASA GLDAS-2.1 Noah land surface model (uses satellite + ground observations), monthly, 1 degree
datasets.citation: Beaudoing, H. and M. Rodell, NASA/GSFC/HSL, 2020: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 monthly 1.0 x 1.0 degree V2.1. NASA GES DISC. https://doi.org/10.5067/LWTYSMP3VM5Z ; Rodell, M. et al., 2004, Bull. Amer. Meteor. Soc. 85, 381-394.
datasets.explain: Water leaving the land as vapour, from soil and through plant leaves.

datasets.title: Surface runoff to streams (NASA GLDAS)
datasets.mission: NASA GLDAS-2.1 Noah land surface model (uses satellite + ground observations), monthly, 1 degree
datasets.citation: Beaudoing, H. and M. Rodell, NASA/GSFC/HSL, 2020: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 monthly 1.0 x 1.0 degree V2.1. NASA GES DISC. https://doi.org/10.5067/LWTYSMP3VM5Z ; Rodell, M. et al., 2004, Bull. Amer. Meteor. Soc. 85, 381-394.
datasets.explain: Rain that runs off the surface into streams and rivers instead of soaking in - a stand-in for streamflow.

datasets.title: Soil moisture, top 10 cm (NASA GLDAS)
datasets.mission: NASA GLDAS-2.1 Noah land surface model (uses satellite + ground observations), monthly, 1 degree
datasets.citation: Beaudoing, H. and M. Rodell, NASA/GSFC/HSL, 2020: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 monthly 1.0 x 1.0 degree V2.1. NASA GES DISC. https://doi.org/10.5067/LWTYSMP3VM5Z ; Rodell, M. et al., 2004, Bull. Amer. Meteor. Soc. 85, 381-394.
datasets.explain: How much water sits in the top 10 cm of soil - what crops and plants can drink.

datasets.title: Rainfall (GPCP v2.3, satellite + gauges)
datasets.mission: Global Precipitation Climatology Project v2.3 (NASA GSFC; SSM/I, TRMM/GPM-era satellites + rain gauges)
datasets.citation: Adler, R.F. et al., 2018: The Global Precipitation Climatology Project (GPCP) monthly analysis (new version 2.3) and a review of 2017 global precipitation. Atmosphere, 9(4), 138. Data via NOAA PSL, https://psl.noaa.gov/data/gridded/data.gpcp.html
datasets.explain: Rain and snow over land and sea, blended from satellites and rain gauges since 1979.

datasets.title: Rainfall from space (NASA GPM IMERG)
datasets.mission: NASA/JAXA Global Precipitation Measurement, IMERG Final Run V07 monthly
datasets.citation: Huffman, G. J., E. F. Stocker, D. T. Bolvin, E. J. Nelkin, Jackson Tan, 2023: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07. NASA GES DISC. https://doi.org/10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-MONTH/07
datasets.explain: Rain and snow measured by a fleet of satellites, every month since 2000.

datasets.title: Water stored on land (NASA GRACE / GRACE-FO)
datasets.mission: NASA/DLR GRACE (2002-2017) and NASA/GFZ GRACE-FO (2018-) gravity satellites, JPL RL06.3Mv04 mascons
datasets.citation: Wiese, D. N., D.-N. Yuan, C. Boening, F. W. Landerer, M. M. Watkins, 2023: JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO Mascon Ocean, Ice, and Hydrology Equivalent Water Height Coastal Resolution Improvement (CRI) Filtered RL06.3Mv04. PO.DAAC, CA, USA. https://doi.org/10.5067/TEMSC-3JC634
datasets.explain: All the water stored on and under the land - groundwater, soil water, snow - weighed from space by gravity.

datasets.title: Air temperature near the ground (NASA MERRA-2)
datasets.mission: NASA GMAO MERRA-2 reanalysis (M2TMNXSLV, monthly means of Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct)
datasets.citation: Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO), 2015: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_slv_Nx: 2d, Monthly mean, Single-Level, Assimilation, Single-Level Diagnostics V5.12.4. NASA GES DISC. https://doi.org/10.5067/AP1B0BA5PD2K ; Gelaro, R. et al., 2017, J. Climate 30, 5419-5454.
datasets.explain: Air temperature 2 m above the ground from NASA's weather-history model, which blends satellite and ground data.

datasets.title: El Niño index (NOAA ONI, Niño-3.4)
datasets.mission: NOAA ERSSTv5 sea surface temperature (Pacific Nino-3.4 region)
datasets.citation: NOAA Climate Prediction Center, Oceanic Nino Index (ONI), ERSSTv5. https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/data/indices/
datasets.explain: El Nino / La Nina: warm or cool swings of the tropical Pacific that shift rain around the world.

datasets.title: Antarctic sea ice extent (NSIDC Sea Ice Index)
datasets.mission: NASA Nimbus-7 SMMR, DMSP SSM/I-SSMIS, JAXA GCOM-W AMSR2 passive microwave (NSIDC G02135 v4)
datasets.citation: Fetterer, F., K. Knowles, W. N. Meier, M. Savoie, A. K. Windnagel, T. Stafford, 2025: Sea Ice Index, Version 4 (G02135). NSIDC, Boulder, Colorado USA. https://doi.org/10.7265/a98x-0f50
datasets.explain: The area of ocean around Antarctica covered by floating ice.

datasets.title: Arctic sea ice extent (NSIDC Sea Ice Index)
datasets.mission: NASA Nimbus-7 SMMR, DMSP SSM/I-SSMIS, JAXA GCOM-W AMSR2 passive microwave (NSIDC G02135 v4)
datasets.citation: Fetterer, F., K. Knowles, W. N. Meier, M. Savoie, A. K. Windnagel, T. Stafford, 2025: Sea Ice Index, Version 4 (G02135). NSIDC, Boulder, Colorado USA. https://doi.org/10.7265/a98x-0f50
datasets.explain: The area of ocean around the North Pole covered by floating ice.
